interface.adapter: Snapshot every complete read OR written slot, including all8 physical words of conditionally-written slots. Original masked/unmasked stores determine final active/inactive bit patterns; copying identical inactive private bits is not publication to an external output.
interface.core: Entry loads the compact slots once into separate fully initialized vector allocas. Every original context bank/tag/status access is rewritten to the matching isolated local alloca. The compact buffer is not the working arithmetic bank and is never passed to math. All original CFG/FP/arithmetic/core calls remain in this one clone. Every normal return stores written locals back to compact slots.
interface.lifetime: Adapter compact alloca has explicit lifetime start/end around the call and copyback. Each core local has64-byte alignment and dominates all cloned paths; original memory access alignments are retained and >64 rejected. Actual stack allocation/coloring/reuse is an emitted-code question.
interface.readonly_view: Every original offset0 pointer load is bound to the one real readonly global-view value. The walker follows loads/GEPs and the exact ReadOriginal helper to existing read-only AVX512 gathers. Any context/view store, pointer capture, integerization, unknown callee, indirect call, dynamic context offset or partial slot access rejects. Actual external input views cannot alias compiler-private context/compact/local banks.
interface.no_context_in_core: The old context formal maps temporarily to poison during CloneFunctionInto only. All reviewed memory operands are replaced, the offset0 load is replaced with the real view argument, every dead context-derived GEP must disappear, and unknown uses reject. No pointer/index/mask freezing and no context-allocation surrogate is introduced.

local_masked_normalization.domain: Only the proven complete initialized vector allocas created for projected local bank/tag/status slots. Never global inputs/outputs, actual row-data gathers, caller context memory, compact boundary memory or unrelated existing allocas.
local_masked_normalization.masked_load: Ordinary local load then select(original definedmask,loaded,original passthrough). Keep the exact passthrough including poison in originally excluded values.
local_masked_normalization.masked_store: Ordinary old local load then select(original definedmask,new,old), followed by an ordinary local store. Initialized old physical lanes preserve every inactive word.
local_masked_normalization.proof: Exact input module plus original full-context memset/physical-bank initialization and defined ISPC mask source proof. New local initialization is explicit on the sole core entry and dominates the cloned CFG. Mask values are neither frozen nor replaced. This is a source-bound proof, not a generic lane/poison engine.
